item_key.description: Stable item identifier used to join predictions with downstream records.

scores.description: Per-attribute model scores. Index i corresponds to vocabulary label index i.
scores.unavailable_semantics: Use null when no trained model/checkpoint is available; never emit fabricated scores.

support_mask.description: Inference-time availability/support mask. 1 means the attribute is supported by the current model/vocabulary; 0 means unavailable or unsupported.

observation_mask.description: Training/evaluation observation mask. 1 means ground-truth evidence is observed; 0 means unknown/unannotated. This mask is distinct from support_mask.

attribute_source.description: Provenance of the attribute vocabulary/annotation source.

model_version.description: Version identifier of the model producing the scores.
